hooks.name: Load steering at session start
hooks.description: At session start, surfaces the repo's .kiro/steering files so their conventions are loaded before doing work.

action.command: if [ -d .kiro/steering ] && [ -n "$(ls -A .kiro/steering 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "This repo has steering files in .kiro/steering. Read all of them before writing code, editing repo files, or drafting commit messages, and follow their conventions:"; for f in .kiro/steering/*.md; do echo "  - $f"; done; fi
